text_en: The Lord said to Moses: Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: No one shall defile himself for a dead person among his relatives,
text_cn: 上主对梅瑟说：“你当训示亚郎的儿子司祭说：司祭不应为族人的尸体陷于不洁，

text_en: except for his nearest kin: his mother, his father, his son, his daughter, his brother;
text_cn: 除非为骨肉至亲，如母亲，父亲，儿女，兄弟；

text_en: likewise, for a virgin sister, close to him because she has had no husband, he may defile himself for her.
text_cn: 未出嫁而仍为处女的姊妹，为她的尸体，司祭可陷于不洁；

text_en: But he shall not defile himself as a husband among his people and so profane himself.
text_cn: 但司祭不可因为身为丈夫，而为姻亲的尸身，陷于不洁，亵渎己身。

text_en: They shall not make bald spots upon their heads, or shave off the edges of their beards, or make any gashes in their flesh.
text_cn: 司祭的头发不可剃光，胡须的边缘，不可修剪，也不可纹身割伤。

text_en: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God; for they offer the Lord ’s offerings by fire, the food of their God; therefore they shall be holy.
text_cn: 他们对天主应是圣的，不可亵渎天主的名号，因为是他们奉献上主的火祭，作为天主的供物，所以应是圣的。

text_en: They shall not marry a prostitute or a woman who has been defiled; neither shall they marry a woman divorced from her husband. For they are holy to their God,
text_cn: 司祭不可娶妓女和受玷污的女人为妻，也不可娶为丈夫离弃的女人，因为他是祝圣于天主的人。

text_en: and you shall treat them as holy, since they offer the food of your God; they shall be holy to you, for I the Lord , I who sanctify you, am holy.
text_cn: 所以你应以他为圣，因为他把供物奉献给你的天主，他对于你应是圣的，因为使你们成圣的我上主，是圣的。

text_en: When the daughter of a priest profanes herself through prostitution, she profanes her father; she shall be burned to death.
text_cn: 若司祭的女儿卖淫亵渎自己，她是亵渎自己的父亲，应用火烧死。

text_en: The priest who is exalted above his fellows, on whose head the anointing oil has been poured and who has been consecrated to wear the vestments, shall not dishevel his hair, nor tear his vestments.
text_cn: 兄弟中身分最高的司祭，头上既倒过圣油，又被祝圣穿了祭衣，不可披头散发，不可撕裂自己的衣服。

text_en: He shall not go where there is a dead body; he shall not defile himself even for his father or mother.
text_cn: 不可走近死人的尸体，也不可为父亲或母亲的尸体而陷于不洁。

text_en: He shall not go outside the sanctuary and thus profane the sanctuary of his God; for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 也不可走出圣所，免得亵渎天主的圣所，因为在他头上有天主傅油的神印：我是上主。

text_en: He shall marry only a woman who is a virgin.
text_cn: 他应娶处女为妻；

text_en: A widow, or a divorced woman, or a woman who has been defiled, a prostitute, these he shall not marry. He shall marry a virgin of his own kin,
text_cn: 寡妇，弃妇或受玷污的妓女，这样的女人，决不可娶；只可娶本族中的处女为妻，

text_en: that he may not profane his offspring among his kin; for I am the Lord ; I sanctify him.
text_cn: 以免亵渎本族的后裔，因为那使他成圣的是我，上主。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to Aaron and say: No one of your offspring throughout their generations who has a blemish may approach to offer the food of his God.
text_cn: “你告诉亚郎说：世世代代你的后裔中，

text_en: For no one who has a blemish shall draw near, one who is blind or lame, or one who has a mutilated face or a limb too long,
text_cn: 凡身上有缺陷的，不得前去向天主奉献供物；凡身上有缺陷的，不准前去：不论是眼瞎，脚跛，残废，畸形的，

text_en: or one who has a broken foot or a broken hand,
text_cn: 或是断脚断手的，

text_en: or a hunchback, or a dwarf, or a man with a blemish in his eyes or an itching disease or scabs or crushed testicles.
text_cn: 或是驼背，矮小，眼生白翳，身上有麻疹或癣疥，或是睾丸破碎的人。

text_en: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has a blemish shall come near to offer the Lord ’s offerings by fire; since he has a blemish, he shall not come near to offer the food of his God.
text_cn: 亚郎司祭的后裔中，凡身上有缺陷的，不得去奉献上主的火祭；他身上既有缺陷，就不应给天主奉献供物。

text_en: He may eat the food of his God, of the most holy as well as of the holy.
text_cn: 天主的供物，不论是至圣的或圣的，他都可以吃；

text_en: But he shall not come near the curtain or approach the altar, because he has a blemish, that he may not profane my sanctuaries; for I am the Lord ; I sanctify them.
text_cn: 却不可进入帐幔后，或走近祭坛前，因为他身上有缺陷，免得他亵渎我的圣所，因为使他们成圣的是我，上主。”

text_en: Thus Moses spoke to Aaron and to his sons and to all the people of Israel.
text_cn: 梅瑟就这样训示了亚郎和他的儿子，以及全体以色列子民。
